filters.name: Align by ICP (vcglib)
filters.shortDescription: Compute an ICP transform that aligns one mesh layer to another.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Perform Iterative Closest Point alignment between a fixed reference layer and a moving source layer. The source layer transform is updated; vertex coordinates are not baked. Existing layer transforms are used as the initial pose, so the alignment follows what is visible in the 3D view.

parameters.label: Reference Mesh
parameters.help: The mesh kept fixed during ICP.

parameters.label: Source Mesh
parameters.help: The mesh whose transform will be updated to match the reference.

parameters.label: Sample Number
parameters.help: Number of source samples used at each ICP iteration.

parameters.label: Minimal Starting Distance
parameters.help: Initial maximum correspondence distance. Only source samples nearer than this value are used.

parameters.label: Target Distance
parameters.help: ICP stops when the median sample distance goes below this value.

parameters.label: Max Iteration Num
parameters.help: Maximum number of ICP iterations.

parameters.label: Normal Equalized Sampling
parameters.help: Distribute samples uniformly with respect to normal directions instead of spatial random sampling.

parameters.label: MSD Reduce Factor
parameters.help: Percentile used to reduce the maximum correspondence distance at each iteration.

parameters.label: Sample Cut High
parameters.help: Discard samples farther than this percentile of the current correspondence distances.

parameters.label: Rigid Matching
parameters.help: If enabled, ICP solves only rotations and translations. If disabled, similarity matching may include scale.

parameters.label: Vertex Only
parameters.help: Use closest vertices instead of closest points on faces. This is automatically used for point clouds.

parameters.label: Max Normal Angle
parameters.help: Maximum angle, in degrees, between source and reference normals for accepted correspondences.

parameters.label: Min Matched Points
parameters.help: Minimum number of accepted point pairs required for an ICP iteration to be valid.

parameters.label: Save Last Iteration
parameters.help: Create two diagnostic point layers containing the last accepted source samples and their reference correspondences.

parameters.label: Random seed
parameters.help: Zero draws a fresh seed on every run, so repeated applications differ; any other value makes the sub-sampling of the moving mesh exactly reproducible.

filters.name: Align Meshes Globally
filters.shortDescription: Globally align overlapping mesh layers using pairwise ICP arcs.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Build an overlap graph among the selected document layers, run ICP on sufficiently overlapping layer pairs, then solve a global alignment. The chosen base mesh remains fixed and the other layer transforms are updated without baking coordinates.

parameters.label: Base Mesh
parameters.help: The layer that remains fixed while the other aligned layers are moved.

parameters.label: Only Visible Meshes
parameters.help: If enabled, align only visible layers. The base mesh must be visible.

parameters.label: Occupancy Grid Size
parameters.help: Resolution budget used to detect overlapping mesh pairs.

parameters.label: Arc Area Thr.
parameters.help: Only mesh pairs with normalized overlap above this threshold become ICP arcs.

parameters.label: Recalc Fraction
parameters.help: Fraction of existing high-error arcs to recompute during iterative global alignment. This port computes arcs once, so the value is retained for MeshLab parameter compatibility.

parameters.label: Sample Number
parameters.help: Number of source samples used for each pairwise ICP arc.

parameters.label: Minimal Starting Distance
parameters.help: Initial maximum correspondence distance.

parameters.label: Target Distance
parameters.help: ICP stop distance for each pairwise arc.

parameters.label: Max Iteration Num
parameters.help: Maximum number of ICP iterations for each pairwise arc.

parameters.label: Normal Equalized Sampling
parameters.help: Distribute samples uniformly with respect to normal directions.

parameters.label: MSD Reduce Factor
parameters.help: Percentile used to reduce correspondence distance.

parameters.label: Sample Cut High
parameters.help: Discard samples farther than this percentile.

parameters.label: Rigid Matching
parameters.help: If enabled, pairwise and global alignment use rigid transforms.

parameters.label: Vertex Only
parameters.help: Use closest vertices instead of closest points on faces.

parameters.label: Max Normal Angle
parameters.help: Maximum accepted normal angle in degrees.

parameters.label: Min Matched Points
parameters.help: Minimum number of matched point pairs required for a valid pairwise ICP arc.

parameters.label: Random seed
parameters.help: Zero draws a fresh seed on every run, so repeated applications differ; any other value makes the sub-sampling of each aligned pair exactly reproducible.

filters.name: Measure Layer Overlap
filters.shortDescription: Report which mesh layers overlap in an occupancy grid.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Voxelize all mesh layers into an occupancy grid and report the pairs that occupy common cells. This is an information filter and does not modify the document.

parameters.label: Occupancy Grid Size
parameters.help: Resolution budget used by the occupancy grid.
